title: Sanctioned and Actual strength of Total Jail Staff during 1997
pdf_title: Sanctioned and Actual strength of Total Jail Staff during 1997
notes: An analysis of the sanctioned and actual staff strength in the jails shows
that almost in all the States/UTs from where information had been sent, the actual
strength of the Jail Staff posted against the sanctioned strength is quite
satisfactory. Kerala, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Chandigarh are the
States/UTs which reported 100% strength during 1997. While in Punjab, actual
strength was higher than the sanctioned strength.
